mapper.select: SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.nickname, up.avatar, up.bio FROM user_profile up INNER JOIN user u ON up.user_id = u.id WHERE up.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY (CASE WHEN up.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, up.nickname ASC
